scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @tiles-town/contracts run build && pnpm run docker:up && pnpm --filter @tiles-town/web run dev
scripts.dev:web: pnpm --filter @tiles-town/contracts run build && pnpm --filter @tiles-town/web run dev
scripts.clean: turbo run clean && pnpm exec rimraf .turbo test-results
scripts.lint: pnpm run eslint && pnpm run stylelint
scripts.verify: pnpm run tsc && pnpm run lint && pnpm run test
scripts.eslint: pnpm exec eslint apps/api apps/web packages tests playwright.config.ts eslint.config.js
scripts.docker:refresh: pnpm run docker:destroy && pnpm run docker:up
scripts.e2e: pnpm --filter @tiles-town/contracts run build && pnpm --filter @tiles-town/testkit run build && node -e "const { execSync } = require('node:child_process'); if (!process.env.CI) { execSync('pnpm run docker:up', { stdio: 'inherit' }); }" && playwright test
